_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Status of Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) Report
summary: This report describes status and supply condition data about Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) which the contractor has received under the contract.
description_purpose:
3.1 This report describes status and supply condition data about Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) which the contractor has received under the contract.

3.2 This report will be used to review the condition, installation and effectiveness of the GFE.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.

7.2 This DID is applicable to contracts in which GFE has been provided to the contractor in support of the contract.

7.3 This DID supersedes UDI-P-25581.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following information:

children.title: List of Government Furnished Equipment by Nomenclature.
National Stock Number of each equipment.
Condition of each equipment, in accordance with the equipment condition status listed below:
Serviceable Usable Without Qualification.
children.content: New, used, repaired, or reconditioned equipment which is serviceable and usable without limitation or restriction.

children.title: Serviceable Usable With Qualification.
children.content: New, used, repaired, or reconditioned equipment which is serviceable and useable for its intended purpose but which is restricted from issue to specific units, activities, or Geographical areas by reason of its limited usefulness or short service-life expectancy.

children.title: Serviceable Test/Modification.
children.content: Serviceable equipment which requires test, alteration, modification, conversion or disassembly. This does not include items which must be inspected or tested immediately prior to issue.

children.title: Unserviceable Reparable.
children.content: Economically reparable equipment which requires repair, overhauls, or reconditioning.

children.title: Unserviceable Incomplete.
children.content: Equipment requiring additional parts or components to complete the end item prior to issue.

children.title: Unserviceable Condemned.
children.content: Equipment which has been determined to be unserviceable and can not be repaired.

children.title: Unserviceable Reclamation.
children.content: Equipment determined to be unserviceable, uneconomically reparable as a result of physical inspection, tear down, or engineering decision. Item contains serviceable components or assemblies to be reclaimed.

children.title: Status of use of the Government Furnished Equipment.
Solutions of problems relating to 2.6 and 2.7 above.
Request for assistance for repair of the GFE, as necessary.
